slot.brief: Ask why transition metal ions are coloured (d–d transition) and match a given ion with its colour.

stem: The colour of the hexaaquacobalt(II) ion, $[\text{Co}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$, is due to which process?

verdicts.working: [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ is pink because of d–d transitions.

working:
$[\text{Co}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ is pink.
Its partially filled $d$ subshell permits visible-light $d$–$d$ transitions.

Independent check: [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ is pink because of d–d transitions.
